Personal reusable design system

Your reusable trippy 3D UI arsenal.

This pack is made for direct use: copy icons, copy components, open full templates, and drop the shared CSS into any static app, React app, client landing page, command deck, portfolio, music page, camera app, sales handout, or internal tool.

Open the use-case mapOpen component libraryUse templates

Not a demo. A copy-bank.

Every folder is organized around reuse: assets, components, templates, social cards, brand kit, docs, and copy blocks.

✅Open index.html to browse
✅Copy assets folder into projects
✅Paste components/templates by use case
Step 1

Use the same visual language everywhere.

Copy assets into a project and link the CSS. Every icon/component/template snaps into the same system.

Step 2

Pick by use case.

Need a client pitch page, camera app, artist storefront, command deck, or portfolio? Open the matching template.

Step 3

Edit names and sections.

Change text, images, links, and icons. No build tool required.
